request.style: English, festive orchestral Christmas anthem, mixed choir with children's choir descant, full orchestra, French horns, tubular bells, timpani, harp, glowing and majestic, 76 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The prophets watched through ages for the one the LORD would send
A king to reign on David's throne whose peace would have no end
Then in the fields of Bethlehem the shepherds kept the night
And the glory of the Lord shone round them, a great and holy light

[Pre-Chorus]
The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light
On those who lived in a land of deep shadow, light has dawned

[Chorus]
For to us a child is born, to us a son is given
And the government will rest on his shoulders
And his name shall be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God
Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace

[Verse]
He came to what was his own, and his own did not receive
But to all who took him in, to all who would believe
The one through whom all things were made, the light of all mankind
Lay wrapped in cloths and in a manger, as the angel said they'd find

[Chorus]
For to us a child is born, to us a son is given
And the government will rest on his shoulders
And his name shall be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God
Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace

[Bridge]
And the Word became flesh and made his dwelling among us
And we have seen his glory
Full of grace and truth
Glory to God in the highest
And on earth peace to those on whom his favor rests

[Outro]
Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace
Glory to God in the highest
